notes: Public requirements baseline BL-REQ-0003 with 159 shall-statements (rationale, G/W/T acceptance, planned vs executed). No requirement is Verified solely because code exists. Minimum target: 102.

requirements.title: Third-party model provenance disclosure
requirements.text: Engineering Model Provenance shall state that third-party foundation models were not trained by OtaconsKeep.

requirements.title: No OK-trained foundation claim
requirements.text: Public Models & Data shall state OtaconsKeep does not claim to have trained the third-party foundation weights it routes to.

requirements.title: Quantization documented in benches
requirements.text: MEASURED benchmark rows shall state model family and quantization when applicable.

requirements.title: Personality not prompt-only goal
requirements.text: Continuity-enabled agents shall treat personality parameters as numeric modulators, not solely a system-prompt adjective list.

requirements.title: Context window honesty
requirements.text: Docs shall not imply infinite context; long chats may summarize or truncate per implementation.

requirements.title: Temperature defaults documented
requirements.text: Default sampling parameters shall be documented or visible in config.

requirements.title: Installer honesty on incomplete lab proof
requirements.text: Public documentation shall not claim full Windows WSL end-to-end release-gate proof while the automated lab path remains unconfirmed.
requirements.rationale: Honesty as brand; avoids vaporous “verified install” claims.

requirements.title: Emotional continuity state vector
requirements.text: Where emotional continuity is enabled, each agent shall maintain a bounded continuous state vector including irritation, jealousy, hurt, trust, attachment, confidence, and anxiety.
requirements.rationale: About thesis: remembering ≠ being affected. State enables measurable persistence.

requirements.title: Asymmetric emotional inertia
requirements.text: Emotional updates shall use asymmetric inertia so provocation accrues more readily than repair recovers for high-inertia personalities.
requirements.rationale: Matches human-like repair asymmetry; implemented by _blend().

acceptance.then: net state remains above start (repair incomplete)

requirements.title: Personality parameter vector
requirements.text: Emotional continuity shall apply per-agent personality parameters including comparison_sensitivity, rejection_sensitivity, anger_inertia, jealousy_inertia, trust_recovery, trust_damage, and decay_per_neutral.
requirements.rationale: Same event must not affect all agents equally.

requirements.title: Idle decay of fast affect
requirements.text: Fast affect dimensions (irritation, jealousy, hurt, anxiety) shall decay over idle time according to decay_per_neutral and ~90s step sizing, capped.
requirements.rationale: Prevents permanent lock at peak without events.

acceptance.then: J decreases by ≥ one decay step

requirements.title: Apology does not instantly zero state
requirements.text: A classified apology event shall not reset jealousy/irritation/hurt to baseline in a single step for high-inertia agents.
requirements.rationale: About: apologies do not instantly erase history.

requirements.title: Directional relationships
requirements.text: Agent relationship edges shall be directional: strength(A→B) need not equal strength(B→A).

requirements.title: Restart persistence of emotional state
requirements.text: Emotional continuity state shall persist across process restart via durable local storage.
requirements.rationale: Measurable restart persistence metric from About.

requirements.title: Directed relationships
requirements.text: Relationship edges shall be directed (A→B need not equal B→A).

requirements.title: Restart persistence of continuity state
requirements.text: Continuity state shall persist across process restart when continuity is enabled.

requirements.title: No fabricated consciousness claim
requirements.text: Public Engineering and product copy shall not claim the Continuity Model proves consciousness.

requirements.title: Emotion selection from state
requirements.text: When emotion labels are displayed, selection shall derive from the state vector via documented scoring (CM-08) or equivalent.
requirements.rationale: Labels must not be random prompt fluff when continuity is on.

acceptance.given: state dominated by high anxiety dims

requirements.title: Event delta caps
requirements.text: Per-cycle or per-event affect deltas shall respect documented caps when stability layer is enabled.
requirements.rationale: CM-13 stability; one message must not nuke relationship mass.

requirements.title: Identity anchor floor
requirements.text: Adaptive output blend shall keep identity weight β_i at or above β_min when identity anchor is enabled.

requirements.title: MOCK traces labeled
requirements.text: Teaching/synthetic continuity traces published on Engineering shall be labeled MOCK.

requirements.title: Markov stage analysis optional
requirements.text: Discrete emotional stage transitions may be analyzed as a Markov model (CM-24) without replacing continuous state as source of truth.

requirements.title: Apology repair path
requirements.text: Continuity-enabled agents shall support an apology/repair event class that reduces hurt/jealousy per documented rules.

requirements.title: Rival heat map
requirements.text: Continuity shall maintain rival heat scores when comparison events name rivals.

requirements.title: Disengage threshold
requirements.text: When irritation exceeds disengage_threshold, continuity shall mark a disengage stage/label per profile.

requirements.title: Trust recovery rate
requirements.text: Trust recovery events shall apply profile trust_recovery coefficients.

requirements.title: Social influence optional
requirements.text: CM-06 social influence shall be optional and off unless social adapters are configured.

requirements.title: Codec conversation surface
requirements.text: The system shall provide a Codec/Command Center conversation surface for talking to a selected agent.
requirements.rationale: About thesis: contact someone, not dump a prompt.

acceptance.then: can send a message to an agent

requirements.title: Agent switch without session loss
requirements.text: Switching the active agent in Codec shall not destroy other agents' persisted histories.

acceptance.given: agents A and B have history

requirements.title: Local URL default
requirements.text: The default Codec/Command Center endpoint shall bind to a local loopback address for the standard Lite path.
requirements.rationale: Local-first: no surprise public bind by default.

requirements.title: Streaming or progressive reply
requirements.text: Codec replies shall support progressive display when the model runtime provides streaming tokens.
requirements.rationale: TTFT perception and Deck LIVE feel.

acceptance.then: tokens appear before full completion OR documented non-stream fallback

requirements.title: Voice path optional
requirements.text: Voice input/output shall be optional and not block text Codec operation when STT/TTS is unavailable.
requirements.rationale: Text-first Keep must work on CPU-only hosts.

requirements.title: Error surfaced to operator
requirements.text: When model routing fails, Codec shall surface a human-readable error instead of a silent hang.

requirements.title: Continuity context injection hook
requirements.text: When continuity modules are enabled, Codec reply assembly shall be able to include continuity-derived context.
requirements.rationale: Math → SEQ-001 pipeline requires a hook.

acceptance.then: assembled context includes continuity fields OR documented skip

requirements.title: Hard refresh safety
requirements.text: Browser hard-refresh shall not wipe server-side agent memory.

requirements.title: Message timeout
requirements.text: Codec shall enforce a maximum wait timeout for model responses and surface timeout errors.

requirements.title: Empty message rejected
requirements.text: Codec shall reject empty messages without calling the model backend.

requirements.title: Distinguish MOCK vs MEASURED evidence
requirements.text: Published analysis and benchmark artifacts shall be labeled MOCK, MEASURED, or REFERENCE-KEEP-REDACTED.

requirements.title: No training on operator chats by default
requirements.text: Lite shall not upload operator chats for OtaconsKeep model training by default.

requirements.title: Export/delete design intent
requirements.text: Design Intent: operators in regulated contexts should eventually export/delete local agent data via documented tools.

requirements.title: No identifying telemetry by default
requirements.text: Lite shall not enable identifying telemetry by default.

requirements.title: Public requirements register
requirements.text: Engineering portal shall publish a structured requirements register with unique IDs.

requirements.title: VCRM Planned vs Executed
requirements.text: VCRM shall distinguish Planned vs Executed verification columns.

requirements.title: No fabricated PASS
requirements.text: Engineering JSON shall not mark Verified/PASS without evidence objects.

requirements.title: Continuity Model published
requirements.text: Engineering Math shall publish Continuity Model equations CM-01…CM-25 with write-ups.

requirements.title: Risk narratives
requirements.text: Published risks shall include scenario, cause chain, and mitigation strategy depth.

requirements.title: Analysis MOCK watermark
requirements.text: Analysis datasets that are synthetic shall be labeled MOCK/SYNTHETIC.

requirements.title: Traceability links
requirements.text: Requirements shall support links to architecture and tests where allocated.

requirements.title: Schema version published
requirements.text: Engineering meta shall publish schema_version and last_audited date.

requirements.title: Requirements baseline ID
requirements.text: Requirements package shall publish baseline_id.

requirements.title: Known issues register
requirements.text: Engineering shall publish a Known Issues register.

requirements.title: Releases register
requirements.text: Engineering shall publish a Releases/qualification register.

requirements.title: Expansion boundary honesty
requirements.text: Public materials shall not claim Reference Keep multi-node farm as automatic Expansion READY on every PC.

requirements.title: Aria + Deck/Codec installable
requirements.text: Expansion foundation shall make Aria chat and Deck/Codec surfaces installable when Core is present.

requirements.title: Studio optional sidecar
requirements.text: Genome/Video Studio paths shall be marked optional and may require Docker/GPU sidecars.

requirements.title: Foundation READY meanings published
requirements.text: FOUNDATION READY / DEGRADED / FAILED meanings shall be published for Expansion installer exits.

requirements.title: Licensed gate for Expansion features
requirements.text: Expansion-gated features shall require a valid license seat where the product marks them Premium.

acceptance.then: access denied or unlock path shown

requirements.title: Roster schema validation
requirements.text: Expansion foundation shall validate agent roster schema before READY.

requirements.title: Creation timestamp preserved
requirements.text: Expansion reruns shall preserve each agent's original creation timestamp.

requirements.title: Persistent agents
requirements.text: The system shall support creating and managing persistent agents with separate conversation history and long-term memory.
requirements.rationale: Without per-agent persistence, Codec “contact someone” UX collapses to disposable chat.

acceptance.given: two agents A and B exist
acceptance.then: A history does not appear in B transcript after restart

requirements.title: Provider-neutral capability routing
requirements.text: The system shall allow swapping LLM/TTS/STT backends without changing agent identity configuration.
requirements.rationale: Identity must outlive any single model vendor.

requirements.title: Codec contact metaphor
requirements.text: When Codec/Deck surfaces are present, the operator shall be able to select an agent identity and continue a conversation that retains prior context for that identity.

requirements.title: Tool execution path
requirements.text: Agent runtime shall be able to invoke configured tools and return tool results into the conversation pipeline.

requirements.title: Expansion five-agent roster
requirements.text: Public Expansion shall provision a five-agent Lite roster (Aria, Vector, Ledger, Muse, Sentry) with hierarchy placement.

requirements.title: Honest Expansion sidecar status
requirements.text: Public Expansion documentation shall distinguish Available now vs Requires extra setup for Genome and Video Studio.

acceptance.then: not marked READY on every fresh PC

requirements.title: Agent delete confirmation
requirements.text: Deleting an agent shall require confirmation when UI supports delete.

requirements.title: Default agent present
requirements.text: Fresh Lite install shall provide at least one usable default agent path.

requirements.title: Tools permission gate
requirements.text: Destructive tools shall require explicit enablement or confirmation where implemented.

requirements.title: Session concurrency note
requirements.text: Docs shall note single-operator local concurrency expectations for Lite.

requirements.title: VRAM-tier default model selection
requirements.text: Default Model installation shall select an Ollama chat model tier based on detected VRAM: under 6GB → qwen2.5:1.5b; ≥6 → 3b; ≥8 → 7b; ≥16 → 14b.
requirements.rationale: Avoid installing oversized models that thrash low-VRAM machines.

acceptance.then: selected tag is 7b class per published table

requirements.title: GPU optional
requirements.text: A discrete NVIDIA GPU shall be optional for basic text Lite operation.

requirements.title: VRAM table published
requirements.text: Public materials shall publish VRAM tier guidance for Default Model selection.

requirements.title: Measured SKU honesty
requirements.text: Only GPUs actually measured may be labeled MEASURED in Engineering benchmarks.

requirements.title: Multi-GPU non-requirement
requirements.text: Lite shall not require multi-GPU for basic operation.

requirements.title: HTTP JSON API contract
requirements.text: Core shall expose a documented HTTP JSON API for UI/agent requests (IF-002 class).

requirements.title: Ollama inference interface
requirements.text: Model runtime integration shall use a documented inference request interface (IF-001 class).

requirements.title: OS feature ops interface
requirements.text: Installer OS feature operations shall be isolated behind a documented IF-003-style boundary.

requirements.title: Discord optional adapter
requirements.text: Discord integration shall be optional and disabled unless configured.

requirements.title: Home Assistant optional adapter
requirements.text: Home Assistant integration shall be optional and disabled unless configured.

requirements.title: API schema examples
requirements.text: API documentation shall include schema examples or OpenAPI when available.

requirements.title: Websocket optional
requirements.text: Realtime channels, if any, shall be optional and documented separately from HTTP JSON.

requirements.title: Windows one-click install resume
requirements.text: Windows Setup shall request reboot when WSL2 enablement requires it and resume installation afterward rather than restarting from zero.

acceptance.then: install resumes without wiping prior progress

requirements.title: GPU detection repair helper
requirements.text: A published Fix-Otacon-GPU helper shall exist for operators whose GPU/chat path is incorrect after install.

requirements.title: Installer stage logging
requirements.text: The installer shall write a stage-tagged log file with timestamps for each major install phase.
requirements.rationale: Support triage and evidence packs need reproducible logs.

requirements.title: Prerequisite detection
requirements.text: The installer shall detect missing prerequisites (disk, virtualization, admin rights where required) before long downloads begin.

acceptance.then: clear fail with remediation before model download

requirements.title: Linux / WSL documented path
requirements.text: The system shall document a Linux/WSL install path functionally equivalent for Core services.
requirements.rationale: Not all operators are on Windows.

requirements.title: Soft-update without data wipe
requirements.text: A soft-update shall refresh code/helpers without wiping agent memory stores by default.
requirements.rationale: Continuity promise fails if updates erase memory.

requirements.title: Expansion requires Core
requirements.text: The Expansion installer shall refuse to proceed if Core/Lite is not detected at the expected path (or OTACON_INSTALL_DIR).

requirements.title: Install health check gate
requirements.text: The installer shall run a post-install health check before declaring completion.
requirements.rationale: Completion without health check trains false confidence.

requirements.title: Idempotent re-run
requirements.text: Re-running the installer on an already-installed Core shall be safe (no duplicate agent wipe).
requirements.rationale: Operators re-run when stuck; must not punish them.

requirements.title: Published download integrity metadata
requirements.text: Public download pages shall publish integrity metadata (hash and/or size) for primary Setup artifacts when practical.

acceptance.then: hash or size is visible for primary artifact

requirements.title: Installer disk space estimate
requirements.text: The installer shall warn when free disk is below a documented minimum before large downloads.

requirements.title: Network failure retry
requirements.text: The installer shall allow retry after transient network failures without discarding completed stages when resume points exist.

requirements.title: Uninstall guidance published
requirements.text: Public docs shall describe how to stop services and where data lives for uninstall/cleanup.

requirements.title: Local Ollama interface
requirements.text: Chat Default Model path shall communicate with a local Ollama endpoint on the operator machine.
requirements.rationale: Local-first inference boundary for Default Model.

acceptance.then: traffic targets local Ollama API without OtaconsKeep cloud credential

requirements.title: Web UI to Core API
requirements.text: Operator web surfaces shall communicate with Core via local HTTP JSON APIs with login gate where enabled.

requirements.title: Cross-reference validation
requirements.text: Engineering package validation shall fail on duplicate IDs and unknown requirement/test references.

requirements.title: Diagram fullscreen
requirements.text: System Models shall support fullscreen viewing of diagrams.

requirements.title: Conversation store durability
requirements.text: Conversation history shall persist across service restarts on local storage.

requirements.title: Long-term memory store
requirements.text: The system shall provide a long-term memory store distinct from raw conversation transcript where implemented.

requirements.title: Memory isolation between agents
requirements.text: Agent A's memory artifacts shall not be readable as Agent B's without an explicit shared-memory feature.

acceptance.then: B cannot retrieve A's fact via normal Codec

requirements.title: Export path design intent
requirements.text: The system shall define a documented export path for operator-owned memory (even if UI is incomplete).

acceptance.then: documented path or explicit Not yet published

requirements.title: Corruption detection note
requirements.text: On memory store read failure, the system shall log a clear corruption/read error rather than silently inventing empty history as success.

requirements.title: Backup recommendation published
requirements.text: Public docs shall recommend backup of the memory volume/path.

requirements.title: Memory path configurable
requirements.text: Advanced operators shall be able to configure the memory storage path via documented settings.

requirements.title: Transcript pagination
requirements.text: Long conversation transcripts shall be loadable without requiring a single unbounded UI payload.

requirements.title: Optional integrations offline-safe
requirements.text: Home Assistant, Discord, and ARR integrations shall be optional; Core shall remain usable when they are absent.

requirements.title: Optional WAN features degrade
requirements.text: Optional WAN features (providers, Discord) shall degrade without breaking local Core chat.

requirements.title: Proxy documentation design intent
requirements.text: Corporate proxy/TLS interception notes shall be documented as Design Intent for Windows install.

requirements.title: Rate limit design intent
requirements.text: Design Intent: local API should eventually support simple rate limiting for non-loopback binds.

requirements.title: Discord support channel published
requirements.text: A public Discord invite for support shall remain linked from site chrome.

requirements.title: FAQ install triage
requirements.text: FAQ shall include install triage for Lite and Expansion foundation failures.

requirements.title: Engineering FAQ honesty
requirements.text: FAQ shall explain Verified, Pending VCRM, and Lite vs Reference claims.

requirements.title: About deep-links to Math
requirements.text: About measurable-emotion section shall deep-link to Engineering Math/Behavioral Models.

requirements.title: Home proof strip
requirements.text: Home page shall show a live-ish evidence proof strip sourced from Engineering counts.

requirements.title: Status page honesty
requirements.text: Expansion status page shall distinguish shipped vs roadmap items.

requirements.title: Attribution page
requirements.text: About shall include inspiration/attribution disclaimers for Metal Gear references.

requirements.title: CPU-capable Lite path
requirements.text: Lite shall remain operable without a dedicated GPU by selecting a smaller local model configuration.
requirements.rationale: Gatekeeping Lite behind discrete GPUs would contradict free public foundation claims.

acceptance.then: chat path answers using small-model tier

requirements.title: Publish Lite benchmark plan
requirements.text: Engineering portal shall publish a Lite benchmark plan covering cold start, TTFT, tokens/s by VRAM tier, install duration, and Codec round-trip before claiming performance.

acceptance.then: plan present; measured rows labeled MEASURED or MOCK

requirements.title: TTFT measurable
requirements.text: Time-to-first-token shall be measurable for streaming-capable local chat paths.

requirements.title: CPU fallback path
requirements.text: Lite shall remain usable on sub-6GB VRAM / CPU-small-model path with reduced capability, not hard-fail.

requirements.title: BVT runtime budget documented
requirements.text: Behavioral verification tests shall declare an expected runtime budget when published.

acceptance.then: budget stated or Not yet published

requirements.title: Benchmark N published
requirements.text: MEASURED benchmark rows shall publish N (run count).

requirements.title: Codec round-trip class
requirements.text: Benchmark plan shall include Codec round-trip latency as a class.

requirements.title: Agent relationship Formula 5
requirements.text: Agent-to-agent relationship strength updates shall follow Formula 5: new = clamp(cur + delta - 0.008*(cur - 0.50), 0, 1).
requirements.rationale: Slow drift to neutral prevents permanent lock-in without events.

requirements.title: KeepRoute mission continuity
requirements.text: KeepRoute shall preserve mission/checkpoint state across model or provider switches mediated by OmniRoute.

requirements.title: Log rotation design intent
requirements.text: Service logs shall have a documented rotation or size-management approach.

requirements.title: Health endpoint
requirements.text: Core shall expose a health/ready check for local monitoring.

requirements.title: Provider-neutral capability routing
requirements.text: Model/capability routing shall support selecting among configured local or remote backends without rewriting agent identity.

requirements.title: VRAM-tier model suggestion
requirements.text: Default Model path shall recommend or select a model tier appropriate to detected VRAM when using Ollama.

acceptance.then: suggested tier matches published table band

requirements.title: Ollama loopback default
requirements.text: The Default Model path shall target local Ollama on loopback unless operator overrides.

requirements.title: Graceful missing backend
requirements.text: If the selected backend is unreachable, routing shall fail closed with an error (no silent fallback to a different provider unless configured).
requirements.rationale: Prevents surprise data exfil / wrong brain.

requirements.title: KeepRoute mission state
requirements.text: KeepRoute shall preserve mission/checkpoint state across model switches for supported workflows.

requirements.title: No silent model upgrade
requirements.text: Automatic model pulls shall not replace an operator-pinned model without notice when pinning is supported.

requirements.title: Tokens/s not claimed without label
requirements.text: Public Engineering benchmarks shall label MEASURED vs SIMULATED vs MOCK for throughput rows.

requirements.title: STT backend selectable
requirements.text: When STT is enabled, backend selection shall be configurable independently of LLM backend.

requirements.title: TTS backend selectable
requirements.text: When TTS is enabled, backend selection shall be configurable independently of LLM backend.

requirements.title: Capability matrix published
requirements.text: Engineering Overview shall publish a Lite/Expansion/Reference capability matrix.

requirements.title: No vendor account dependency for local operation
requirements.text: Lite, AI9, and Expansion foundation layers shall not require authentication against OtaconsKeep operator private accounts for local operation.

requirements.title: Public Engineering secret hygiene
requirements.text: Published Engineering JSON and evidence shall not contain private IPs, API tokens, passwords, or private keys.

requirements.title: Operator-owned credentials
requirements.text: Integrations requiring third-party credentials shall use operator-supplied secrets, not OtaconsKeep-hosted shared accounts.

requirements.title: License seat anti-sharing policy published
requirements.text: Premium seat sharing policy shall be published for Expansion license unlocks.

requirements.title: Default deny remote bind
requirements.text: Services shall not advertise a public bind address by default in Lite docs/config.

requirements.title: Redacted evidence only
requirements.text: Public EVID packs shall be redacted of secrets and private host identifiers.

requirements.title: Dependency pin guidance
requirements.text: Release notes shall call out critical dependency upgrades that affect install security.

acceptance.then: called out or Not yet published

requirements.title: CORS default local
requirements.text: Default web UI CORS/origin policy shall prefer local operator use.

requirements.title: Public Lite free of license key
requirements.text: OtaconsKeep Lite shall not require a license key or artificial time limit for Core operation.

requirements.title: Unit tests for clamp/blend
requirements.text: Clamp and blend helpers shall have unit tests in the continuity test inventory.

requirements.title: Public validator script
requirements.text: Repository shall include validate-engineering.py (or successor) enforcing ID uniqueness and secret scan.

requirements.title: Status vocabulary enforced
requirements.text: Requirement and risk statuses shall use the published status vocabulary.

requirements.title: Public site static hosting
requirements.text: Public engineering site shall be statically hostable (no server secrets required to render).

requirements.title: Mermaid diagrams client-side
requirements.text: SysML diagrams shall render via client-side Mermaid without private network calls beyond CDN.

requirements.title: Local-first operation
requirements.text: The system shall operate primarily on hardware controlled by the operator, with agent identity and memory persisted locally.
requirements.rationale: Public promise: Your agents. Your hardware. Your data. Differentiates OtaconsKeep from account-hosted chatbots.
assumptions: Operator controls the machine and local credentials
constraints: Optional remote providers may be configured by operator

acceptance.then: history is readable after service restart without cloud login

requirements.title: Tool calls optional
requirements.text: Agent tool execution shall be optional per request/capability and fail safely when tools are disabled.

requirements.title: REX not Lite-default claim
requirements.text: Public Lite claims shall not list REX propose→verify as a Lite-default surface.
requirements.rationale: Overview capability matrix red for Lite REX.

requirements.title: REX states documented
requirements.text: When REX is in scope for a deployment, proposal states shall follow the documented STM-001 lifecycle.

requirements.title: Product explainer dual modes
requirements.text: Primary product cards shall provide Quick Explanation and Technical Deep Dive without navigating away.

requirements.title: Contrast readable
requirements.text: Engineering portal text shall remain readable on the dark VOID theme.

requirements.title: Mobile nav works
requirements.text: Site topnav shall function on narrow viewports.
